item.title: BELLE MORTE Release New Video for ‘Lace’ (Acoustic Version)
item.description: Symphonic gothic metal project BELLE MORTE keeps expanding its world with new acoustic versions of songs from the acclaimed album Pearl Hunting. “Lace,” originally featured on the previous record Crime of Passion, returns as a special release to mark the sixth anniversary of one of the band’s most notable singles. item.title: PREDATORY VOID Announce New EP “Atoned In Metamorphosis” + Release First Single ‘Contemplation In Time’
item.description: Belgian sludge/doom collective Predatory Void, featuring members of Amenra, Oathbreaker and Cobra The Impaler, return with Atoned in Metamorphosis, their second release and most focused artistic work to date. Set for release on 6th February 2026 via Pelagic Records, the four-track EP distills the band’s volatile creative energy into a tightly honed expression of intensity, restraint and emotional upheaval. item.title: FUNERAL HOME Release New Single ‘My Kingdom Is Hell’ – Dedicated to Rock Legend Lemmy Kilmister
item.description: Finnish Kuopio-based death metal band Funeral Home is set to release their debut album ‘Your Funeral’ on January 16th 2026 via Inverse Records. The second single ‘My Kingdom Is Hell’ is unleashed today and it’s available on all essential streaming services: https://push.fm/fl/funeral-home-my-kingdom The band comments: “My Kingdom Is Hell” is dedicated to rock legend and Motörhead frontman Lemmy Kilmister. item.description: Swedish record label ViciSolum Productions proudly announces the signing of Norwegian prog–avantgarde metal veterans RAM-ZET. After more than a decade away from the spotlight, the band is officially back in action, reigniting their unique blend of progressive and avantgarde metal. item.title: INHERITED TIME Release First Single ‘Capella’ from Upcoming Debut Album
item.description: Finnish metal band Inherited Time has released the first single Capella from their upcoming debut album, set to be released next year. Capella combines modern melodic metal with symphonic metal elements into a tight, rolling, sci-fi-themed track that tells the story of humanity uniting to rescue a civilization beyond the stars rather than saving themselves.
